Add FIX as a deployment-capacity candidate rather than an equipment manufacturer; track MEP labor, modular fabrication, and commissioning as potential bottlenecks.

Need separate pass for ADR/foreign-listed leaders and private suppliers: Schneider Electric, Legrand, Stulz, Delta Electronics, LiquidStack, OptiCool, CoolIT, JetCool, and Motivair may be critical but are not clean US-listed common-stock candidates.

node: Data-center thermal management and on-site power distribution stack
summary: Expanded the universe around the hypothesis that AI data-center bottlenecks are shifting toward qualified, integrated cooling, rack-level power, switchgear, and deployment capacity. The highest-relevance second-order names found in this pass are nVent, Modine, Powell Industries, Belden, and Comfort Systems USA. These are not recommendations; they are research candidates for evidence tracking.
